system.description: When you select this Talent, choose one Trained Skill. Whenever you roll a Natural 19 or a Natural 20 on a Skill Check with that Skill, you gain the benefits of the Critical Skill Success Talent and also gain Bonus Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier. You can select this Talent multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different Skill to gain the benefits of this Talent.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy of Intrigue
